metadata.question: Was the sulfer dioxide concentration higher over Cumbre Vieja than the Funchal Island on October 18, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Question: Compare SO2 concentration between Cumbre Vieja and Funchal Island on October 18, 2021. 2. Data: Need SO2 concentration data. TROPOMI/Sentinel-5P has SO2 data. 3. Locations: - Cumbre Vieja: Volcano in Canary Islands (approx 28.57°N, 17.83°W) - Funchal Island: I think they mean Madeira Island where Funchal is located (approx 32.65°N, 16.91°W) 4. Strategy: - Get TROPOMI SO2 data for October 18, 2021 - Define geometries for both locations - Calculate mean SO2 concentration for each - Compare values 5. Potential issues: - Cloud cover affecting SO2 measurements - No data available for that specific date - Need to check pixel counts to ensure valid data Let me structure the code: 1. Define geometries for both locations 2. Get TROPOMI SO2 data for the specific date 3. Check if collection has data 4. Calculate mean SO2 for each location 5. Validate results and output answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry Definitions const cumbreVieja = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.83, 28.57]); // Cumbre Vieja volcano const funchal = ee.Geometry.Point([-16.91, 32.65]); // Funchal, Madeira Island // Buffer areas around points for regional analysis const cumbreViejaArea = cumbreVieja.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer const funchalArea = funchal.buffer(50000); // 50km buffer // 2. Data Acquisition - TROPOMI SO2 data const date = '2021-10-18'; const so2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .select('SO2_column_number_density'); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = so2Collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`SO2 Images on ${date}: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the single image for that day const so2Image = so2Collection.first(); // 3. Processing - Calculate mean SO2 for each location const cumbreStats = so2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: cumbreViejaArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const funchalStats = so2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: funchalArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const cumbreMean = cumbreStats.get('SO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const cumbreCount = cumbreStats.get('SO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); const funchalMean = funchalStats.get('SO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const funchalCount = funchalStats.get('SO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Cumbre Vieja - SO2: ${cumbreMean?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${cumbreCount}`); console.log(`Funchal - SO2: ${funthalMean?.toFixed(6)}, Pixels: ${funthalCount}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (cumbreCount === 0 || funchalCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); } else if (cumbreMean === null || funchalMean === null || isNaN(cumbreMean) || isNaN(funthalMean)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (cumbreMean > funchalMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
